title: CamelBak Eddy+ Kids Insulated Water Bottle 14oz

comparisons.notes: Exact match: model 2283401040, Scuba Sharks, 14oz, insulated. Page says In Stock, ships from US, plus $5.99 shipping.

writeup: Woot has the CamelBak Eddy+ Kids Insulated 14oz water bottle (model 2283401040, Scuba Sharks) new for $7.99. IBSPOT sells the exact same insulated bottle for $30.33 plus shipping, and the insulated 14oz version looks discontinued at most other retailers. It has double-wall insulation and a leak-proof bite-valve straw. Only three were left when we checked, with a limit of three per customer.
